items.heading: Dambou
details: Key ingredients: rice, cabbage, meat, peanut oil
Steam shredded cabbage until very soft.
Mix the cabbage with cooked rice and shredded meat.
Season with peanut oil and spices.
Steam the mixture again briefly before serving.

items.heading: Tuwo with Miyan Kuka
details: Key ingredients: millet or corn flour, baobab leaf powder, meat
Whisk millet or corn flour into boiling water into a stiff dough (tuwo).
Simmer meat in a broth thickened with baobab leaf powder.
Cook until the sauce is smooth and slightly stretchy.
Serve the dough alongside the sauce.

items.heading: Tuwo
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.

items.heading: Jollof Rice
details: Ingredients: rice, vegetables or protein, onion/garlic, oil, seasoning and water/stock.
Cook the rice by absorption or steaming.
Sauté the other ingredients separately, combine and season to taste.
